ownership.quote: H Company, also known simply as H, is a French artificial intelligence startup which develops "action-oriented" artificial intelligence agents for enterprise automation and productivity.

stage.quote: H, a startup based in Paris and previously known as Holistic AI, has announced a $220 million seed round just a few months after the company's inception.
stage.note: This oversized $220M round is explicitly reported as the company's seed round; no later priced round (Series A/B/etc.) has been reported as of the check date.

total_funding_usd.basis: Only disclosed priced round to date; Wikipedia states 'H Company raised $220 million since its inception', matching the TechCrunch/SiliconAngle seed round reporting.
total_funding_usd.quote: H Company raised $220 million since its inception.

last_round.quote: In May 2024, H Company closed a record-setting $220 million seed round, at the time the largest AI raise in Europe.

note: Founded 2023 in Paris as Holistic AI, renamed H Company. Three of five original co-founders (Wiestra, Tuyls, Perollat, all ex-DeepMind) left in August 2024 over operational disagreements. Charles Kantor (co-founder/CEO) was replaced as CEO in June 2025 by Gautier Cloix (formerly CEO of Palantir France), who is pivoting the company toward a 'forward deployed engineers' model. Acquired Mithril Security in May 2025. Product line reviewed here (H Agents API / Surfer) is a cloud browser-agent product; pricing page and docs pricing table reportedly conflict (see card caveats).
